## 6851496735c7

**Reproduced validator/domain defect.** The generator documents solid rectangles of at least 3×3, but `self_check()` accepts a nonrectangular five-cell L. The exact 10×10 input has color `3` at `(2,2)`, `(3,2)`, `(4,2)`, `(4,3)`, `(4,4)` and returns no validator errors. It is outside the documented generated grammar but inside the validator-accepted domain.

**Plausible shortcut.** “Outline a component only when it is already a solid rectangle; otherwise leave it unchanged” fits the canonical demonstrations and routine generated samples. On the accepted L, that rival leaves the L unchanged, while the canonical Racket rule outputs the full 3×3 bounding-box outline. The supported apply command executed rule hash `6bba75bb466d`, generator SHA `1b82be04e20ddd2045f26b849d98c30541ebce2961e3e19781b79c5c80114899`, and output SHA `209feb44860972941e0ebc361882f1c05f0e840d24c55d235e688580d2960979`.

**Additional formal findings.** Lint fails because `RULE_HASH` is missing and two one-token axes are not probed. The profile floor has 0/60 exact or envelope canonical-profile hits across all bands. A documented-valid override (`hard`, 10×10, `n_rects=6`) is rejected because hard generation internally requires height 16–18.

Evidence: `checks/audit/6851496735c7/input.json`, `probe.json`, `racket.json`, `lint/`, and `profile-floor/`. No fix was made because this was an audit-only target.
